title: Norwegian Bacon Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful dish perfect for dinner or a snack. The combination of smoky bacon and peppery flavor will transport you to the fjords of Norway.
instructions: Wrap bacon slices around the peppercorns, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Thread the bacon-peppercorn bundles onto the skewers, leaving some space between each.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until the bacon is crispy.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
